stem_book: A small block of mass 0.1 kg lies on a fixed inclined plane PQ which makes an angle θ with the horizontal (Q at the top, P at the bottom). A horizontal force of 1 N acts on the block through its centre of mass, pushing it towards the incline, as shown in the figure. The block remains stationary if (Take g = 10 m/s²) (a) θ = 45° (b) θ > 45° and a frictional force acts on the block towards P (c) θ > 45° and a frictional force acts on the block towards Q (d) θ < 45° and a frictional force acts on the block towards Q
key: c θ > 45° and friction acts towards Q
reason: Key 'c' only (printed key also c), but at θ = 45° the components balance (sinθ = cosθ) so (a) is also true — this is JEE 2010, official answer (A),(C); ask as multi-correct.
work: Along incline: mg sinθ = sinθ (towards P) vs 1·cosθ (towards Q): θ = 45° balanced; θ > 45° net towards P → friction towards Q
